title: Analysis of target mRNAs in the fixed-frozen human brain using a modified BaseScope-ISH Assay protocol
protocol: Place the slides horizontally on a flat surface and let them thaw for 1–2 min on the bench until most of the moisture has evaporated from the tissue.
Add a thin layer of 10% NBF directly on the tissue and incubate for 60 min at 20°C–25°C.
Use sufficient NBF to cover the entire tissue section, approximately 300 μL per 2 × 2 cm sections.
Remove NBF by gently tilting each slide on a paper tissue.
Wash slides with PBS directly added to the glass using a pipette while placed on a flat surface.
Remove PBS by gently tilting each slide on a paper tissue.
Repeat washes every 2 min for three times.
Dehydrate in freshly prepared 70% ethanol for 3 min before moving into 100% ethanol for 3 min.
Equilibrate protease and BaseScope probes at 20°C–25°C for at least 30 minutes before use.
Place two heat-resistant coplin jars in the steamer: one containing 100 mL distilled water and one containing 100 mL of 1× target retrieval reagent.
Switch on and pre-heat the steamer to 90°C–99°C.
Arrange slides horizontally in the plastic rack provided with the HybEz oven.
Add appropriate number of drops of Hydrogen Peroxide directly on the dry tissue.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Place the rack in distilled water and move it gently 3–5 times.
Repeat once, replacing with fresh water.
Move all the slides into a vertical rack, then place it quickly in the coplin jar with distilled water at 90°C for 10 s to acclimatize.
Quickly move slides into the coplin jar with 1× target retrieval reagent at 90°C and keep covered for 15 min.
Remove slides from the steamer and transfer to a container with distilled water at 20°C–25°C for 10 s to acclimatize.
Wash slides in fresh 100% ethanol for 3 min, then repeat once.
Dry slides in the dry oven at 60°C for 20 min.
Draw a barrier 2-4 times around each section using a hydrophobic barrier pen.
Allow the drawn barrier to dry completely at 20°C–25°C.
Place slides in the plastic rack, then insert the rack into the aluminium tray.
Apply the correct number of drops of protease IV directly on the dry tissue.
Incubate in the HybEz oven at 40°C for 30 minutes.
Remove the plastic rack with the slides from the oven tray and quickly put the empty tray back into the oven to prevent cooling.
Wash the slides in distilled water for 2 minutes.
Gently shake the tray/slides to remove excess liquid.
Repeat washing once more as before.
Place the rack back in the warm oven tray.
Add the correct number of drops of the appropriate BaseScope probe.
Incubate in the HybEz oven at 40°C for 2 hours.
Wash once with 1× wash buffer for 2 minutes and gently shake to remove excess liquid.
Place the 8 bottles of amplification reagents (AMP 1–8) at 20°C–25°C for 30 minutes before use.
Turn on the HybEz oven and set to 40°C.
Place humidifying paper in the tray and wet with distilled water.
Warm the tray for at least 20 minutes before use.
Switch on dry oven to 60°C.
Wash slides with 1× wash buffer for 2 minutes at 20°C–25°C and gently shake to remove excess liquid.
If slides were kept in SSC buffer, repeat the wash twice.
Do not let the slides dry during washes.
Place the rack back in the warm oven tray.
Add the correct number of drops of AMP1 solution.
Incubate in the HybEz oven for 30 minutes at 40°C.
Put the empty tray back into the oven.
Wash twice for 2 minutes at 20°C–25°C and remove excess liquid.
Place the rack back in the warm oven tray.
Add the correct number of drops of AMP2 solution.
Incubate in the HybEz oven for 30 minutes at 40°C.
Put the empty tray back into the oven.
Wash twice for 2 min at 20°C–25°C and remove excess liquid.
Place the rack back in the warm oven tray.
Add the correct number of drops of the AMP3 solution.
Incubate in the HybEz oven for 15 min at 40°C.
Put the empty tray back into the oven.
Wash twice for 2 min at 20°C–25°C and remove excess liquid.
Place the rack back in the warm oven tray.
Add the correct number of drops of the AMP4 solution.
Incubate in the HybEz oven for 30 min at 40°C.
Put the empty tray back into the oven.
Wash twice for 2 min at 20°C–25°C and remove excess liquid.
Place the rack back in the warm oven tray.
Add the correct number of drops of the AMP5 solution.
Incubate in the HybEz oven for 30 min at 40°C.
Put the empty tray back into the oven.
Wash twice for 2 min at 20°C–25°C and remove excess liquid.
Place the rack back in the warm oven tray.
Add the correct number of drops of the AMP6 solution.
Incubate in the HybEz oven for 15 min at 40°C.
Wash twice for 2 min at 20°C–25°C and remove excess liquid.
Add the correct number of drops of the AMP7 solution.
Incubate in the HybEz oven for 30 min at 20°C–25°C.
Wash twice for 2 min at 20°C–25°C and remove excess liquid.
Add the correct number of drops of the AMP8 solution.
Incubate in the HybEz oven for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Spin down the Fast RED-B tube.
Dilute 1:60 to prepare Fast RED-A.
Mix well and shield from light.
Shake the rack to remove excess liquid.
Pipette the corresponding volume of the Fast RED mixture.
Close the lid of the oven tray.
Incubate for 10 min at 20°C–25°C, shielded from light.
Place sections in a glass jar with tap water quickly after incubation.
Rinse sections again with fresh tap water.
Place the slides on a thick paper tissue.
Use a Pasteur pipette to add some drops of 50% Haematoxylin.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 1–2 min, until sections turn purple.
Remove haematoxylin by gently tilting each slide on the paper tissue before submerging the slides in tap water for 2 min.
Repeat washes 2–3 times, until the water is clear.
Dry slides completely in a 60°C dry oven for 45 min.
Drop the mounting media directly onto the tissue from a close distance to prevent tissue damage.
Gently aspirate any air bubbles using a 10 μL pipette.
Place a few drops of clear nail polish at the edge of each coverslip to seal it.
Allow the mounting media to dry before imaging for better quality images.
Imaging can be performed when the mounting media has dried, ideally the next day.
Image stained tissues using any brightfield microscope with scanning function.
Use an 85% JpgXr compression (24bit depth) to merge tiles into a single file.
